# Ālayavijñāna (storehouse consciousness)

In [Yogācāra](../movements/yogacara.md), an underlying stream of consciousness in which the traces of actions are deposited, like seeds that ripen later. It explains karmic continuity without a permanent self.

**At stake in** : [Nature of the self](../axes/self-nature.md)

**See also** : [Anattā (non-self)](../glossary/anatta.md) · [Vijñaptimātra (representation-only)](../glossary/vijnaptimatra.md)
